name: Alias Buddy for SimpleLogin
summary: Azen am alias SimpleLogin ɣer tansiwin tamagnutin. Alias Buddy yesnulfa yerna yeččar aliasen uɣalen i kečč yerna yessewḥel tibratin ara d-yessekren tansa-ik ilawin.
description:
S SimpleLogin tzemreḍ ad tarreḍ i yal yiwen am yiwen seg yialiasen-ik, maca kan s alias uɣal (reverse alias) i ilaqen ad tesnulfuḍ yerna ad t-tneɣleḍ s ufus. Yiwen n wuccaḍ kan, tansa-ik tilawit teffeɣ. Alias Buddy ixeddem-it i kečč di tazwara n tikkelt ara tsit ɣef Azen. Timahilin
  • Aru ɣer tansa tilawit: fren alias am umazan yerna aru i umedyaz-ik am yal tikkelt. Mi ara tazneḍ, asemmil isnulfa aliasen uɣalen yerna yuzen s tbaṭuyt tameɣtut.
  • Alias ameɣtu i yal asmel: asfaylu asfaylu deg usfaylu n tira yessumer alias i usmel n umaɣnu neɣ yesnulfa amaynut seg yinuzen n yismawen-ik, am shop.amazon@yourdomain.com.
  • Amsefḍi: yessenqad amazan, imaɣnuten, Reply-To, aḍris, iceɣbalen, vCard, tasarut OpenPGP d usezwel send ad teffeɣ tebrat, yerna yessewḥel kra n wayen ara d-yessekren tansa n tbaṭuyt-ik. Isutar n uwitay daɣen ttwasɛan.
  • Tiririyin qqimen ɣef alias: tiririt neɣ tuzzna n tebrat i d-yusan s alias teffeɣ am alias-nni.
  • Agezzu n yialiasen: nadi, ẓreg tizmilin, senteḍ, ssens neɣ kkes yialiasen-ik, yerna sewḥel imdanen, kullec deg yiwen n yitaluɣt n Thunderbird.
  • Tibratin i d-yusan: taqeffalt nnig yal tabrat tessaram alias i d-tekcem seg-s.
Tesriḍ tasarut API n SimpleLogin. Tuseddi n yialiasen uɣalen tesra amtawi SimpleLogin i t-yeǧǧan. Asemmil yettmeslay kan d API n SimpleLogin (app.simplelogin.io, neɣ aqeddac-ik n SimpleLogin). Asagem yella s teglizit. War assaɣ neɣ asentem seg Proton AG neɣ SimpleLogin.
